cards.headline:
Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3's real
upgrade is the Muse model
cards.body: The $449 Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 keeps its camera and features, but Meta's new Muse model upgrades the assistant.

blocks.x: Gizmodo reviews the $449 Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 AI glasses. The camera and AI feature set are the same as before, but Meta's new Muse model is a significant upgrade to the on-glasses assistant.
Spatial audio also arrives through the Meta AI app.

cards.headline:
Alexa Plus, one year in:
better home control, plus ads
cards.body: A year in, Alexa Plus runs the smart home better but isn't ready to run your life, and it now comes with ads.

blocks.x: The Verge spent a year living with Alexa Plus across the Echo Show, Echo Dot and Echo Max.
Amazon's generative-AI assistant is better at running the smart home, but it is not yet ready to run your life, and it now comes with ads.

cards.headline:
Xpanceo's AI contact lenses
could arrive as soon as 2030
cards.body: Dubai-based Xpanceo has spent five years on AI smart contact lenses that could arrive as soon as 2030.

blocks.x: CNET interviews the founders of Dubai-based Xpanceo, which has spent five years building AI-powered smart contact lenses.
The founders describe the lenses as "an AI helper directly on your cornea", and say they could arrive as soon as 2030.
